title: Gina app.json
description: Bundle application configuration. Defines the bundle identity, HTTP/2 upstream proxies, and external API credentials.

name.description: Bundle name. Must match the directory name under src/.

greeting.description: Optional greeting message exposed on the default route.

proxy.description: HTTP/2 upstream proxy definitions. Each key is a logical upstream name; the value describes how to reach it.

apis.description: External API credentials and config, keyed by service name.

metrics.description: Prometheus metrics endpoint configuration. When `enabled` is true, the bundle exposes /_gina/metrics and records HTTP request counters + duration histograms. Requires `prom-client` to be installed in the project's node_modules (peer dependency).

enabled.description: Master opt-in flag. When false (default), no endpoint is exposed and no metrics are collected.

path.description: Endpoint path. Defaults to /_gina/metrics. Custom paths are not yet supported (the router only registers the default).

allowFrom.description: IP allowlist for the metrics endpoint. Requests from any other source receive 403. Defaults to localhost only. Since 0.7.1 a loopback entry admits a scrape only when it connects directly — one relayed by a reverse proxy on the bundle's own host is refused, the same rule as `admin.allowFrom`.

prefix.description: Prefix for every metric name. Defaults to `gina_` (e.g. gina_http_requests_total).

defaultMetrics.description: When true (default), seeds Node.js process metrics via prom-client.collectDefaultMetrics() — heap, GC pause, event loop lag, active handles.

admin.description: Admin-grade /_gina/* endpoint access control. Gates /_gina/info, /_gina/cache/stats, /_gina/cache/clear, /_gina/storage/*, /_gina/release/* and /_gina/maintenance on a per-bundle IP allowlist. Same shape as `metrics.allowFrom` but a separate axis — admin endpoints expose process state (memory, uptime, HTTP/2 session counters, cache contents) and are scope-separately from Prometheus scrapes.

allowFrom.description: IP allowlist for admin /_gina/* endpoints (/_gina/info, /_gina/cache/*, /_gina/storage/*, /_gina/release/*, /_gina/maintenance). Requests from any other source receive 403. Defaults to localhost only (127.0.0.1, ::1). Empty array `[]` denies everyone — explicit lockdown choice. Reads from req.socket.remoteAddress only — X-Forwarded-For is NOT trusted because reverse proxies could spoof it. Since 0.7.1 a loopback entry admits a caller only when it connects directly: a request from 127.0.0.1 or ::1 that carries a proxy signal (an X-Forwarded-* or Forwarded header, or a port-less Host unless server.proxy.requireForwardedHeaders is true) comes from a reverse proxy on the bundle's own host and is refused. List the address of a proxy running on another host to admit what it relays.

jobs.description: Async-job primitive tuning (`lib/job`, #AI6). The primitive is always-on; an absent block means sane defaults with the in-memory record store. Read once at bundle start (gna.js) — changes need a bundle restart.

store.description: Name of a connectors.json entry providing a durable record store (sqlite, redis, mongodb ship implementations). Records then survive a bundle restart and are readable cross-process; the deferred FUNCTION always lives in the creating process only. Fail-fast: a configured store that cannot be built aborts the boot rather than silently falling back to memory. Absent = the in-memory store.

maxConcurrency.description: Max deferred functions running at once in this process; the rest queue. Default 4.

ttl.description: Terminal-record retention, SECONDS: a completed/failed record is swept this long after finishing. Default 3600.

sweepInterval.description: Internal sweep cadence, SECONDS (an unref'd timer — never holds the process open). 0 disables the internal timer (drive lib.job.sweep() yourself). Default 300.

retryBackoffMs.description: Base delay (ms) between attempts of a failed job created with maxAttempts > 1; doubles each attempt. Retries run on the creating process only. Default 1000.

orphanTimeout.description: #B471 — orphan-reclaim ceiling, SECONDS. A non-terminal record whose last transition is older than this (or whose scheduled retry is this far overdue) is presumed stranded by a dead process and terminalized as `failed` with error name `JobOrphanedError`; normal ttl retention then applies. Durable stores only — the built-in memory store is exempt (it cannot hold another process's orphans). A record reclaimed while its origin was merely slow self-corrects on the origin's next write; no completion webhook fires for a reclaim. Default 86400 (24h); 0 or false disables; positive values are floored at 60.

webhookBackoffMs.description: Webhook retry backoff base (ms); doubles each retry. Default 500.

webhookSecret.description: HMAC secret for signing completion-webhook payloads (X-Gina-Signature). Omit to disable signing.

_comment.description: Internal documentation comment. Ignored at runtime.

ca.description: Path to the CA certificate file for TLS verification. Supports ${variable} interpolation.

hostname.description: Upstream host. Use "bundle@project" notation to reference another Gina bundle (e.g. "api@myproject").

port.description: Upstream port. Use "bundle@project" notation to inherit the bundle's configured port.

path.description: Base path prefix for all requests forwarded to this upstream.

requestTimeout.description: Request timeout as a duration string (e.g. "30s", "2m"). Defaults to the framework default if omitted.
